name: Ashguard duelist
design: Slender adult sword duelist; closed steel visor, petrol blue split coat, ochre scarf, steel chest and shoulder plate, dark trousers and leather boots. One straight one-handed steel sword, bronze crossguard. Original design; no copied game artwork.
source_contract: Aseprite route owns drawn pixel poses and separate editable layers. Blender route owns geometry, rig and animation in .blend; final indexed-palette frames and retouches remain editable in .aseprite. Both preserve tags, durations and ground pivot.
